The Iranian front and indirect contacts with the United States remain deadlocked, while the Israeli Navy considers enhancing its anti-submarine warfare capabilities. The domestic political landscape in Israel is intensely polarized between the current leadership and opposition challengers like Gantz and Eisenkot.
